subject.title: feat(memory-core): optional cross-encoder rerank stage for memory search

question: Should OpenClaw accept this public `MemoryRerankProvider` SDK seam plus `memoryRerankProviders` manifest contract as the builtin pre-MMR rerank extension point?
rationale: The branch appears technically sound, but the remaining choice is a durable public plugin API and manifest-contract direction, not a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Accept This SDK Seam After Rebase
options.body: Approve the proposed no-core-config, registration-gated pre-MMR rerank contract, have the contributor resolve merge drift, and land this PR after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Request A Different Boundary
options.body: Keep the design issue open and ask for a revised PR if maintainers prefer a keyed registry, qmd parity, supplement-based route, or another manifest-gating pattern.

options.title: Reject Core Seam For Now
options.body: Close this PR only if maintainers decide current plugin surfaces or ClawHub-hosted plugins are enough and OpenClaw core should not add this SDK API.

recommendation.title: Accept This SDK Seam After Rebase
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed no-core-config, registration-gated pre-MMR rerank contract, have the contributor resolve merge drift, and land this PR after exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is primarily a plugin SDK and manifest contract direction, and recent history points to steipete on those boundary surfaces.
